target.title: fix(qa-lab): use truncateUtf16Safe for tool search gateway and mock OpenAI text truncation
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

QA Lab's tool-search-gateway fixture and mock OpenAI server use naive `.slice(0, N)` to truncate LLM output text for evidence snippets and diagnostic logging. LLM output text may contain non-BMP characters (emoji, CJK extension characters). Naive `.slice(0, N)` at a surrogate pair boundary produces a lone surrogate.

## Changes

- `extensions/qa-lab/src/tool-search-gateway.fixture.ts`: Replace 4 `.slice(0, N)` calls with `truncateUtf16Safe()` for provider input snippet, tool output snippet, and gateway output text (normal + code lanes)
- `extensions/qa-lab/src/providers/mock-openai/server.ts`: Replace 1 `.slice(0, 220)` call in evidence snippet generation with `truncateUtf16Safe()`

Import path follows the qa-lab convention: `import { truncateUtf16Safe } from "openclaw/plugin-sdk/text-utility-runtime"`

## Evidence

Same pattern as the existing `truncateUtf16Safe` usage in:
- `extensions/qa-lab/src/suite-runtime-agent-process.ts` (#102823)
- `extensions/qa-matrix/src/runners/contract/scenario-runtime-shared.ts` (#102656)
